method.AL: and reg,{0FFFFFFFEh,0FFFFFFFCh,0FFFFFFF8h} -> alignment 2/4/8. reg==esp -> kind stack_realign (MSVC frame realignment, no entity). other regs -> forward gate <=8 insns same basic block for [reg(+off)] member use (per user directive), backward same-block def-scan origin; types: 8->double (strong: 8-byte-aligned pointee), 4->int/float (weak: any 4-byte type incl. pointer qualifies), 2->short family. Evidence role: pointee-of-ent alignment (ent holds/IS the aligned pointer).
method.LS: lea dst,[SIB-scaled] scale in {2,4,8}. LS-SCALE=[abs+idx*S] (ds:0[ebp*4]); LS-IDX=[base+idx*S] idx strides S bytes through base pointee; LS-MULT=[r+r*S] multiplier=1+S (index math; stride=multiplier only when dst used as byte offset). Chained forward use <=6 insns same block: [x+dst] -> effective=multiplier (byteoff); [x+dst*N] -> effective=multiplier*N (rescaled); push dst -> alloc-size style (no stride); redefined/call -> none. types attach ONLY to arithmetically pinned effective_stride (byteoff/rescaled); scale-only forms carry no types (multiplier!=scale documented: [esi+esi*4]=x5 not x4; user example semantics covered by LS-SCALE/LS-IDX forms where scale==stride).
method.SS: one base reg (non esp/ebp) accessed at >=3 distinct [reg+const] offsets within <=10 insn positions (window = consecutive accesses with position gap<=10). offsets set = struct member-layout signature; strict superset match vs tools/class_layouts.json (candidate class offsets must contain ALL observed offsets).
method.PP: contiguous push run (>=2) immediately before a call, every operand immediate or offset (string hint from IDA "; \"...\"" comment). kinds: imm / off_str / off_data. cleanup inferred from following insn (add esp,N -> cdecl). complements SP (string_param_types) / CP (const_param_types): joint all-constant argument tuple pattern per call site.
method.entity_attribution: linear this-alias scan (entry prefix before first label/jump + linear def/kill propagation; documented heuristic layer, same spirit as ffl4 als but no CFG join) + backward same-block def-scan for base registers. Entity forms T:FN / M:FN:this:0xOFF / GP:ADDR:0xOFF / G:ADDR / P:FN:k / S:FN:var_N consistent with existing families. Numeric esp/ebp member offsets deliberately NOT attributed (stack drift ambiguity, ffl10 lesson).
method.soundness_notes: AL ptr gate requires observed member use; LS types only on pinned stride; SS strict-superset layout match (no subset relaxation); PP requires every pushed operand constant/string.
